anatomy: Ground slithering limbless long segmented sand worm with open circular three-part grinding mouth, tall black saw-tooth dorsal plates and broad ochre belly. No snake hood, no legs, no ears. Serpent locomotion.

Ground crawling crustacean inside an enormous ancient turquoise ceramic water pitcher shell tilted sideways, six crooked red legs, two equal narrow pincers, long black eye stalks, broken pitcher lip and handle. Small desert hermit monster.

Heavy two-legged walking tall narrow black basalt obelisk creature with angular tapering head atop monolith body, two thick sandstone pillar legs with enormous flat square feet, hanging knotted rope arms ending stone fists, small gold sun inlay eye. Ground heavy stomp.

Hovering desert spirit resembling translucent pear-shaped water jellyfish with a luminous green oasis seed inside, umbrella of layered palm leaf fronds, five short curled water tendrils, no legs, no mask, no arms. Floating hovering locomotion.

Ground limbless serpent with very broad flat hammerhead, pale violet leathery skin, six large separated gold ring scales around long smooth flexible neck, forked bone tail spear, three orange eyes across head. Serpent slither; no hood or dorsal sail or legs.

Floating magical desert spirit shaped like an empty rust bronze spinning wheel with six curved short hooked spokes around hollow turquoise glowing center, suspended long white gauze tassels beneath, no head or body or legs. Hovering animated magical object.

Massive low ground quadruped living chalk salt boulder shaped like a ram, two huge spiral translucent white salt crystal horns, heavy squared hooves, patchy white crystalline fleece, broad face with cobalt eyes, no furnace. Heavy stomp locomotion.

Desert scorpion ground crawler with eight ivory thin legs, long slender emerald jade body, pair tiny pincers, tall arched segmented tail ending broad open red-orange palm-leaf fan of five sharp stingers. Readable fan tail silhouette.
